name: Planks
description: Good oak, or near enough. For patching hull, deck and rudder (Pause > Ship).

name: Nails
description: A fistful of ship's nails, mostly straight. Every repair eats a few.

name: Rope
description: A coil of sound hemp line. For splicing the rigging and lashing the rudder.

name: Sailcloth
description: Heavy canvas for the rigging. Smells faintly of every storm it has seen.
